A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TSFM calibration study. Their complete main texts and appendices are readable, and the equations, tables, and figures can be matched reliably across versions.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of five TSFMs and two baselines, including real and synthetic datasets, prediction-head comparisons, and autoregressive forecasting experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and adds prediction-head accuracy results, two mixture-head comparisons, and evaluation on a GIFT-EVAL subset.

M1.justification: Appendix B.5 adds two replacement prediction-head architectures: five-component Gaussian mixtures and five-component Student's t mixtures. These are additional experimental model variants; the existing backbones, head-training approach, and autoregressive procedures are retained.

E1.justification: Appendix B.6 adds actual evaluation on a filtered GIFT-EVAL subset; v1 cited that benchmark but did not report its own evaluation on it. The original six real datasets, two synthetic controls, and TSMixup head-training data remain.

E2.justification: Figure 18 expands the prediction-head comparison from four alternatives to six by adding Gaussian-mixture and Student's t-mixture heads. The five TSFMs and the N-BEATS and ARIMA baselines remain unchanged, including in the new GIFT-EVAL comparison.

E3.justification: The added GIFT-EVAL experiment specifies 512 context steps, 256 prediction steps, exclusion of series shorter than 768 points, and a maximum of 1,024 series per sub-dataset. These are settings for new evaluation; the original splits, budgets, and forecasting settings are retained.

E4.justification: Figure 13 adds an analysis of point accuracy versus calibration across the existing prediction heads. Appendix B.5 extends the head-sensitivity study to two additional mixture families. The existing synthetic controls, forecast-length analyses, and tail-calibration analyses remain.

E5.justification: Both versions already describe SEM error bars across time series in Figure 2. v2 introduces no new repeated-run or seed information, uncertainty-estimation procedure, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: The original plots and Table 4 values are retained. New Figures 13, 18, and 19 report broadly similar head accuracy, calibration of the additional mixtures comparable to the original non-Gaussian heads, and lower GIFT-EVAL PCE for the TSFMs than for N-BEATS and ARIMA. These are added findings, not improvements over v1 under identical settings.

T1.justification: Appendix B.2 corrects Equation (7)'s MSIS summation endpoint from H to T+L. Other metric edits mainly rename forecast-length symbols. Appendix B.4 also introduces an explicit conditional-independence factorization for forecast blocks, without a theorem or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about TSFM calibration, confidence bias, prediction-head behavior, and long-term autoregressive forecasting. The added appendix evidence does not redefine those central claims.

C2.justification: Appendix B.4 now explains how independently modeled forecast blocks could create biased contexts during autoregressive rollout, alongside error accumulation. v1's corresponding section contained only the plot and caption. The stated limitations concerning zero-shot univariate forecasting and quantile resolution remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 replaces the promised future code release with a statement of availability and a repository address. It also documents the added mixtures' component counts and GIFT-EVAL filtering and sampling rules. The PDFs alone do not establish the repository's contents or usability.

R1.justification: The underlying cited works and research positioning remain unchanged. The duplicate Gneiting reference is consolidated, and publication metadata are revised; the Ovadia-to-Snoek citation change refers to the same uncertainty-under-dataset-shift paper.

P1.justification: v2 updates publication headers, affiliations, acknowledgments, and bibliography formatting; clarifies forecast-length notation; and makes local prose edits. Appendix B.4 is expanded and B.5–B.6 are added, while the main narrative and section order remain largely intact.

P2.justification: Three appendix figures are added: head accuracy/calibration, additional mixture heads, and GIFT-EVAL results. Figure 19 also redisplays the original datasets' results. Existing figures and tables are retained, with subsequent figure renumbering and limited resizing and page reflow.

improvement.justification: The additional head comparisons and GIFT-EVAL evaluation modestly strengthen empirical support, while the code-access statement and MSIS correction improve documentation. The established results remain intact. These gains are limited by incomplete identification of the GIFT-EVAL subset and unclear wording in the new block-bias explanation, including an undefined h in Appendix B.4.
